character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: midnight-blue hair cut just below the shoulders, jade-green eyes, a calm, observant face; an independent explorer of remote waters and wild places, wearing a weather-ready expedition coat, layered travel clothes, and practical boots with far-light orange accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in open deck at night, lit passenger lounge, wake behind the ship; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with night navy, cabin yellow, wake white, far-light orange; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow glide along a deck rail, wide shot of lights across black water, low view of foam in the wake; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
